rules.statement: The rejection of a mortgagee's claim to have property sold subject to the mortgage in an execution proceeding does not bar the mortgagee from subsequently suing on the mortgage bond or seizing the mortgaged property, even if it is later purchased by a third party.
rules.supporting_quote: It seems to me that the refusal did not-touch the mortgagee's rights as against his mortgagor, nor against the land into whosoever possession it might afterwards come.

meta.parties: Supperamanian v. Mohammadu Alliar Et Al
